C1270.title: SSO Identity Account Inconsistency Vulnerability Leading to Account Takeover
C1270.summary: Research reveals that SSO systems heavily rely on email address binding for identity, but overlook the flaw that email addresses can be recycled. Attackers can obtain recycled email addresses and exploit the SSO authentication flow to take over previously associated online accounts without needing passwords, affecting 80% of tested popular websites.
